name: The Maybourne Riviera
positioning: Modernist clifftop hotel above Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, between Menton and Monaco, where every room looks out over the Mediterranean
best_for: Travelers who want sweeping Mediterranean views from their room
Couples wanting a wellness-focused Riviera stay near Monaco
Families and groups who want to take over a whole floor

facts.text: The hotel is built on a cliff face above the village of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, between Menton and Monaco, with Mount Agel behind.
The hotel is a 10-minute drive up a winding road from Monte-Carlo.
Its modernist architecture rises from the rocky peninsula of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin above the Mediterranean.
Every suite and studio opens to views of the Mediterranean, with private balconies.
All rooms have Smart TVs, Bang & Olufsen Bluetooth speakers and Dyson hairdryers.
The hotel has an infinity pool with horizon views.
Surrenne Riviera, the hotel's wellbeing and longevity destination, has a gym and fitness studio overlooking the Mediterranean, with Lagree and spin classes.
Every stay includes full access to Surrenne Riviera and daily English breakfast served in the suite or studio, or at the Riviera Restaurant.
A complimentary shuttle runs to and from Monaco and to the hotel's private beach club.
Suite inclusions include an in-room massage, a sunset cruise and a welcome bottle of chilled champagne.
The Riviera Restaurant has panoramic sea views and serves seasonal, local cuisine inspired by the Mediterranean.
abc kitchens riviera, by Chef Jean-Georges, blends Mediterranean flavours with New York flair on the top floor.

highlights.text: Every room has 180-degree views of the Mediterranean and the coastline stretching from Italy to Monaco.
Duplex suites come with private plunge pools and large furnished terraces, and the signature suites are individually designed.
The Surrenne Riviera spa has a sauna, a steam room and a cold plunge out on the terrace.
Complimentary experiences include Pilates and sunrise yoga, cocktail and pizza-making masterclasses, guided hikes on the Le Corbusier Trail and cultural outings to Roquebrune-Cap-Martin.
In the summer season, guests get access to the private beach club with complimentary sun loungers, subject to availability.

considerations.text: The hotel is up on a cliff, a 10-minute drive up a winding road from Monte-Carlo; a complimentary shuttle runs to Monaco and to the private beach club.
Beach club access with complimentary loungers is for the summer season only and subject to availability.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and limited availability given the hotel's boutique size.
